description: A recording started while the previous one is post-processing shares the single-model asr worker: live moonshine-base-en and final whisper-small-ts evict each other (asr.worker load() disposes the current pipeline), so live captions barely run and the final pass slows. Seen in the Even simulator 2026-09-14: rec 2 started 13:12:08Z during rec 1's final STT (13:11:23-13:12:46Z); rec 2's final pass took 138 s for 42 s. PostProcessor.drain only checks isCapturing between jobs. Fix: post-processing waits at chunk/batch boundaries (final STT groups, speech detection blocks, embedding batches, summary) while capturing and re-ensures its model afterwards; the asr worker serializes a load behind an in-flight transcription so nothing is disposed mid-run. Streaming live models (own worker) are unaffected. Verify with the dev bench (?bench=live&runs=2&wait=0&stt=moonshine-base-en) in the simulator.

comments.text: Landed in jj rev uwulxqqt. Before (sim, runs=2 wait=0 moonshine-base-en + whisper-small-ts): run 2 had 0 captions ('ASR model not loaded', 'asr worker terminated' from the job's release()). After: run 2 first caption 2.39 s, 16 updates, no reloads during capture; final passes pause then complete (112 words each).

title: Post-processing yields the asr worker to live capture
